g.text: KAPUR · BMU/TCU ~23–24 Ma · Lunt 2022, JAES v.230

path.style: fill: url(#he4ddfaaea0); stroke: #fecaca; stroke-width: 0.5; stroke-linejoin: miter

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #fbbf24

g.text: Tectono-chronostratigraphy · this transect · events change character, they are not one ruler

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #94a3b8

g.text: Northern Sabah surfaces stay on the northern end of this line. They are not promoted to southern Sabah or to another basin.

text.style: font-size: 7.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #94a3b8

g.text: TOP ≡ BASE. Project ages are tops of stages; legacy TB ages are bases of the same surfaces.

text.style: font-size: 7.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #94a3b8

g.text: Top III = Base IVA = DRU. Top IVA = Base IVB = LIU. Top IVB = Base IVC = UIU. Top IVC = Base IVD = SRU, and which of those names sits on the pick is HOLD.

text.style: font-size: 7.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #94a3b8

g.text: DRU candidates, not averaged: (a) legacy TB 15.4 (b) legacy recalibrated 14.91 (c) project 14.2 at top NN5, a different surface (d) federation 13.5–12.5.

text.style: font-size: 7.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #94a3b8

g.text: Public bracket 13.77–11.7 Ma is Lunt 2022, Bulletin of the Geological Society of Malaysia 74, single-witnessed. BMU age is the other Lunt 2022 paper, JAES v.230.

text.style: font-size: 7.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #94a3b8

g.text: SABAR is unresolved. One ledger ties it to the DRU, provisional, falsifier still open. The collision profile ties it to the UIU. Both stay.

text.style: font-size: 7.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64748b

g.text: A hold moves on per-well ages above and below the DRU, on an SRU decision at the de-identified deepwater well, and on a well-tied dip line across the trough.

text.style: font-size: 7.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64748b

g.text: NN zone is not a surface. Qualified candidate. This chart is a reading, not a seal.
